adjudicated_findings.observation: 将 whole races suppressed 扩大成“所有种族的人们都受到压迫”，并把 practitioners（从业者）改成“魔法的开拓者”，分别改变了受压迫范围并新增了开创魔法的身份。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'whole races suppressed' ≠ 所有种族的人们; 'misunderstood practitioners' ≠ 开拓者.

adjudicated_findings.observation: Combust 的机制是打断已有的常规燃烧效果并使这些效果立即爆燃；译文改成“立即灼烧目标”，丢失了对已有燃烧效果的指代与一次性引爆关系。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: Combust disrupts existing burning effects and makes them combust at once.

adjudicated_findings.observation: “Swap your paladin Talents”指当前 Sun Paladin 的技能，译成“圣骑士技能”与本条及冻结术语 Sun Paladin=太阳骑士不一致，形成了不存在于该语境的职业称呼。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: Sun Paladin=太阳骑士; 圣骑士 introduced by cycle-0 executor.

adjudicated_findings.observation: terrified creators 表示创造者感到恐惧；“恐怖的创造者”却表示创造者令人恐惧，施受关系反转。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'terrified' = frightened, not terrifying (ORCHESTRATOR held this independently).

adjudicated_findings.observation: 原文明确体力用于驱动散兵的 techniques；“使用体力为其战斗续航”把技能消耗资源的机制泛化成维持战斗，遗漏了体力与技能施放的关系。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'use stamina to fuel their techniques' — match the marauder wording. ORCHESTRATOR adds: the three class-feature bullets were rendered as numbered rhymed slogans with invented flourishes (沾我不到, 堪比流水) instead of '- ' bullets; restore plain bulleted renderings of the three English lines.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 天赋名 Ghoulish Leap 译为“定向跳跃”，与冻结术语 Ghoulish Leap=食尸鬼跳跃冲突。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: Talent name t("Ghoulish Leap","食尸鬼跳跃") in-file; ORCHESTRATOR held this independently.

adjudicated_findings.observation: split yourself into two powerful halves 是将自身分裂为两个强大的半身；“产生两个强大的分身”改成生成两个分身，改变了技能的主体关系和分裂机制。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'split yourself into two powerful halves' — the talent does create a second self; 分身 is a defensible rendering. Left unchanged.

adjudicated_findings.observation: “Summoners are Wilders”明确说明召唤师属于野性系；译文只说“以自然为家”，遗漏了职业分类关系。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'Summoners are Wilders' — class family dropped; sibling sections state it.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 两处关系错误：原文称发光符文使食人魔在魔法狩猎期间无法隐藏，译文却改称这使他们成为首要目标；原文 terrified creators 指惊恐的创造者，译文“让他们惊恐万分的创造者”反转为创造者使食人魔惊恐。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'impossible to hide' ≠ 首要目标; 让他们惊恐万分的创造者 reads as 'creators who terrify them' — still reversed.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 职业特点第一项漏译与 roll 并列的 Vault（跃过/腾跃）动作，只保留了翻滚。
原文 are at home in the wilds 表示召唤师适应、擅长在野外生活，译文“居住在野外”改成了固定居所陈述。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'at home in the wilds' ≠ 居住在野外; the same cycle-0 wording is in oozemancer and wyrmic — fix all three to 以野外为家 for consistency.
